name: finslate
description: FinSlate – Personal Finance PWA (BDT, Modern Slate). Mobile-first React + Vite frontend with Express + MySQL backend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.lint:client: cd client && vite build --mode production --base=/ >/dev/null && echo client builds
